sloka: तस्य दीप्ताग्निसदृशे विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी ।ददृशाते महानेत्रे दीप्ताविव महाग्रहौ ।। ६.६०.६२ ।।।।
transliteration: tasya dīptāgnisadṛśe vidyutsadṛśavarcasī ।dadṛśāte mahānetre dīptāviva mahāgrahau ।। 6.60.62 ।।।।

translations.english: After eating the meat and feeling thirsty, the enemy of Indra drank blood, pails of fat and wine.
